title: Riso lanes assurance — finish, refine, full verify

questions.prompt: What must this single goal complete?
questions.description: Integrator over all eight lane packages under goals/riso-lane-*/. Your chat answers already select full finish + refine + full verification.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Finish incomplete lane packages (NODE/SAAS goal.md + gates if needed), finish/refine every lane against its facts.md, apply open COORD/PLATFORM handoffs end-to-end, preserve exclusive write roots, full verification including render matrix.

options.label: Close package gaps (NODE/SAAS goal.md, incomplete gates)
Finish remaining work for all 8 lanes vs their facts.md
Apply/resolve open handoffs (COORD then PLATFORM follow-through)
Refine/harden in-lane after baseline green (not greenfield redesign)
Full bar: just quality + all sample riso validate + full render_matrix + smokes
Keep exclusive write roots; no foreign-tree fixes without handoff

questions.prompt: How should multi-agent waves be ordered?
questions.description: COORD owns contracts; PLATFORM owns answers/matrix; payload lanes own trees.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Wave 0 package hygiene → Wave 1 COORD apply all open contract handoffs → Wave 2 parallel payload lanes (PY/NODE/SAAS/SYS/DESKTOP/CLI) → Wave 3 PLATFORM answers + full matrix/smoke → Wave 4 assurance report + residual only if blocked.

options.label: COORD first, then parallel payload, then PLATFORM full matrix (Recommended)
Finish payload first; batch COORD handoffs late
Fully serial: COORD→PY→NODE→SAAS→SYS→DESKTOP→CLI→PLATFORM

questions.prompt: How should open handoffs be treated?
questions.description: Known open items include PY api_features/exclude-dirs/graphql-sample, SYS go_version+MCP / rust excludes / rust samples / go api_features answers, PLATFORM mcp_languages typescript, COORD bootstrap-verify.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Triage then apply all non-blocked handoffs in this goal; only defer with written residual + owner when truly blocked by human product decision.

options.label: Apply all open handoffs after triage (Recommended)
Only P0/P1 correctness handoffs; defer modernization samples
Document handoffs only; no contract edits this goal

questions.prompt: How deep should refine/modernize go for lanes that asked for heavy work (esp. SYS/SAAS)?
questions.description: Still respect exclusive write roots and no unsolicited redesign of Copier contracts.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Correctness + coherence first for every lane; then in-lane modernization where the lane plan already scoped it (SYS heavy, SAAS full sweep, DESKTOP deep features); stop short of inventing new product modules.

options.label: Green first, then execute planned refine only (Recommended)
Correctness/gates only — skip heavy modernization
Maximize refine/modernize within every lane plan

questions.prompt: What is the full verification bar for done?
questions.description: You selected full verification in chat.
questions.recommendedAnswer: just quality; all samples riso validate --json; full render_matrix; smoke results per matrix policy; Jinja validation for touched trees; lane-targeted pytest (CLI test_cli, go templates, ci unit); context/agents checks if COORD/PLATFORM touch those surfaces.

options.label: just quality (maintainer)
uv run riso validate on every samples/*/copier-answers.yml
uv run python scripts/ci/render_matrix.py (full) + smokes
validate_jinja_templates on touched/owned trees
Lane-targeted pytest (CLI, go templates, scripts/ci, hooks)
verify_context_sync / validate_agents_ecosystem when those surfaces change

questions.prompt: If full matrix or a sample stays red after owned fixes, what happens?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Goal is not done until green OR every residual has owner lane, failing command, redacted evidence, and explicit human-blocking reason. No silent skip of full matrix.

options.label: Must be green or explicit owned residual with evidence (Recommended)
Best-effort: ship assurance report with known reds
Hard green only — no residuals allowed

questions.prompt: Git / publish policy for this assurance goal?
questions.recommendedAnswer: No branches, commits, or pushes unless you explicitly ask later.

options.label: No branch/commit/push unless explicitly requested later (Recommended)
Atomic conventional commits OK without further ask
Commits + PR OK when green

questions.prompt: What stays out of scope even for this umbrella?
questions.recommendedAnswer: No new product modules beyond lane plans; no hand-edited samples/*/render; no lockfile hand-edits; no secrets; no reintroducing riso-mcp; web wizard only if a lane fact requires it (none do by default).

options.label: No inventing new product modules outside lane plans
Never hand-edit samples/*/render/
Never hand-edit uv.lock / pnpm-lock.yaml
No secrets commit/print/persist
Do not reintroduce maintainer riso-mcp
web/ wizard out of scope unless blocked and assigned
